Bring Scrafty in the back for Intimidate and Fake Out utility against physical attackers like Metagross and Incineroar, and Goodra-Hisui for Sap Sipper immunity to Serperior's Grass moves and solid special bulk.

KEY CALCS: Fire is NEUTRAL vs Goodra-H (Steel 2x x Dragon 0.5x) — Incin sun Flare Blitz does 48.7-131.6% (pair with Rock Slide chip ~8% to secure KO; 2 Blitzes always KO). Incin resists Zard Heat Wave and Goodra's whole kit; it is the safe pivot into both. Serperior Contrary snowball remains wincon vs Scrafty/Zard once Goodra is dead.

Scrafty at -2 is a non-threat.
